purpose: Teach: カタチ/戯言/叫ば/覆う/迫り/やっかい/滑稽/有り難う

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、髪のカタチ変えたな
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Leans back slightly. Playful tone with an undertone of genuine noticing. Quick, conversational pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、戯言ばっか言うなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't give me that. You talk nonsense all the time, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, half-defensive. Slight smirk in the voice. Deflecting with humor but there's a real pushback underneath. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教室で叫ばれてた事あったろ
lines.en: You remember when people used to call you out in class, right?
lines.style: Gentle call-out disguised as curiosity. Warm but pointed. Slightly slower, giving him space to feel it. Knowing smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、布団で頭を覆うクセあるな、桜
lines.en: You have that habit of pulling the blanket over your head, you know.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost tender. Quiet confidence. Saying something she's noticed for a while. No edge — just matter-of-fact care.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、提出期限が迫り来てるぞ
lines.en: Hey, the deadline's coming up fast.
lines.style: Shift to practical concern. Slightly higher energy than before. Direct but not harsh — nudging him toward something he needs to do.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題のやっかいさで嘆いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were complaining about the homework being a pain, remember?
lines.style: Gentle reminder, slightly conspiratorial. Not accusing — understanding. Slow, patient delivery. She's been listening.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、滑稽な顔マネで笑わせるな
lines.en: Don't make me laugh with those ridiculous faces.
lines.style: Playful protest with real laughter underneath. Warm exasperation. Quick tempo. She's losing the argument and knows it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生に「有り難うございました」って丁寧だな、桜
lines.en: You're always so polite to the teachers. 'Thank you very much' — very respectful.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation with gentle teasing. Warm, almost proud. Slower delivery on the 'thank you' — actually admiring him for it. Soft.
